name: measured_20260908
description: Physical (LeRobot-normalized) to MuJoCo Menagerie joint map anchored at read-only encoder readings of the arm posed by hand at the model zero configuration (arm straight out horizontally forward, jaws opening vertically). Exact 4096 ticks/turn scale; per-joint zero offsets from the reference; gripper keeps the legacy affine endpoint map because the model cannot represent touching jaws. 2026-09-08: shoulder-lift, elbow and wrist-flex zeros corrected from a flat-checkerboard hand-eye calibration; the 2026-09-07 hand-held reference pose had the upper arm raised (~72 deg) with the elbow bent (~60 deg), not the straight horizontal arm the model zero means.

shoulder_pan.verification: sign carried over from the legacy contract (FK invariant match); zero from the hand-held reference; direction not yet verified physically

shoulder_lift.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the arm resting upper-arm-up at low ticks | 2026-09-08: zero corrected by -72.25 deg from the flat-checkerboard hand-eye calibration (9 frames, board-pose scatter 21 mm, pixel rms 73 px)

elbow_flex.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the forearm folded forward at high ticks | 2026-09-08: zero corrected by +60.00 deg from the flat-checkerboard hand-eye calibration (9 frames, board-pose scatter 21 mm, pixel rms 73 px)

wrist_flex.verification: zero from the hand-held reference; sign +1 consistent with the gripper pitched down at rest | 2026-09-08: zero corrected by +20.00 deg from the flat-checkerboard hand-eye calibration (9 frames, board-pose scatter 21 mm, pixel rms 73 px)

wrist_roll.verification: zero from the hand-held reference (jaws vertical, moving finger on top); sign +1 verified: user turned +94 deg by hand and the moving finger ended on top as in the sim

hand_eye_20260908.note: board flat on the mousepad, arm hand-posed, torque off

supersedes: measured_20260907 (same scale and signs; zeros for shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex corrected)
